label: AI generation
help: Run one generation with the currently configured AI model. The prompt may reference upstream data; system role, temperature, and a structured response schema are optional.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.title: Prompt
inputs.help: The complete instruction sent to the model. Use 🔗 to include upstream data.
examples: Rewrite this summary as a short notification email: {{node.excel_1.result.summary}}

inputs.name: system
inputs.title: System prompt
inputs.help: Set the model role, for example: You write concise, formal notification emails.

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.title: Temperature
inputs.help: 0–2; leave blank to use the temperature from global AI settings.

inputs.name: responseSchema
inputs.title: Response schema (JSON)
inputs.help: A JSON Schema object. When present, parsed JSON is returned as structured data; the original text is always retained.

outputs.name: data
outputs.title: Structured data
outputs.help: Parsed JSON when a response schema is present; reference fields with {{node.<id>.result.data.field}}.

label: Condition
help: Compare two values, including upstream references, and continue through the matching or non-matching branch.

inputs.name: left
inputs.title: Left value
inputs.help: Value to compare. Use 🔗 to select an upstream input or result.

inputs.name: right
inputs.title: Right value
inputs.help: Target value for comparison; empty checks do not need it.

label: JSON format
help: Pretty-print JSON text for reading or passing to the next step.

inputs.name: json
inputs.title: JSON text
inputs.help: Paste JSON directly or use 🔗 to reference upstream input or output data.
